note: Shared architecture and feature construction. The two training objectives are configured separately and must not be conflated: see pipeline_contrastive.json (primary, distance-based) and pipeline_ce.json (softmax variant).

shared_architecture.conv1: Conv2d(1, 64, kernel=7, stride=2, padding=0) -> 64 x 29 x 29; BatchNorm2d; ReLU
shared_architecture.conv2: Conv2d(64, 128, kernel=7, stride=2, padding=0) -> 128 x 12 x 12; BatchNorm2d; ReLU
shared_architecture.mamba_block: NdMamba2_2d: spatial pad 6->8 (multiple of 8), 64 tokens; fc_in Linear(128,128); one forward and one backward Mamba2 (outputs summed); fc_out Linear(128,128); crop back to 6 x 6
shared_architecture.mamba2_inner: d_state=128, d_conv=4, expand=2, headdim=64, d_inner=256, nheads=4, chunk_size=64; single bidirectional block (not 24 layers)
shared_architecture.head: flatten 128 x 6 x 6 = 4,608; fc1 Linear(4,608 -> 512); dropout rate 0

objective_specific_output.contrastive_pipeline: no classification head; 512-d embedding, Euclidean cdist ranking, BN recalibration (see pipeline_contrastive.json)
objective_specific_output.ce_pipeline: adds Linear(512, n_candidate_hosts), softmax cross-entropy, no BN recalibration (see pipeline_ce.json)

shared_training.early_stopping: no separate callback; fixed epoch budget, checkpoint with highest validation top-1 retained

pyrodigal.per_contig: finder called separately on each contig; no ORF crosses a contig boundary
pyrodigal.stop_codons: TAA/TAG/TGA are part of the 64 ACGT codon bins and are counted in-frame
pyrodigal.ambiguous_codons: codons containing N are absent from the 64 ACGT index and skipped
pyrodigal.codon_denominator: sum of all in-frame codons across predicted ORFs; 64 frequencies sum to 1

fcgr.n_handling: windows containing N are not counted; denominator stays L-k+1
